methods.source_updates: Seven alternating ordinary source-edit builds per mode, after realizing helpers, archives and installed layers. Each mode has its own fresh local file binary cache. Trial zero publishes the initial complete runtime closure; subsequent trials change a checked source marker and publish the entire new closure to the same cache. Counts only newly created compressed NAR files (zstd level 3), excluding narinfo/protocol overhead. Original exports are copied before editing. Attachment metadata remains in the local Nix store; publish dependencies separately for fresh build workers. No other task builds or tests ran concurrently with timing.
methods.initial_preparation: Three rotating nonce-forced builds per mode. Tools and archives are cached, but installed layers are rebuilt including both outputs of the shared derivation. Includes evaluation, native assembly, attachment, NAR hashing and registration. Excludes downloads and helper compilation.
methods.warm_checks: Five alternating nix-build --check runs per mode for subset and full workspace. Installed graphs cached; only final output rebuilt. This is a forced reproducibility check, not an ordinary source-edit timing.
methods.assembler_only: Seven alternating direct-assembly / shared-attachment runs for the CI selection, using identical sources. Archives and shared graph already realized. Excludes graph preparation, cleanup, Nix evaluation, output registration and transfer.
methods.parity: Materialize each shared output, then compare every file hash, executable bit, directory and symlink target with the previous standalone output. Only generated bin and metadata root prefixes normalized. Independent offline pnpm comparison passes for CI; full workspace is compared to baseline due the previously documented upstream workspace verification issue.
methods.runtime: tests/vue-shared.py builds shared, compiler-core, compiler-dom, compiler-ssr and compiler-sfc using real Vue build scripts. A temporary Git index supports Vue git-grep enum scanning. All five bundles match baseline bytes; compiled SFC, SWC and Rollup native parser runtime pass; 50 Vue tests pass with shared dependencies.
methods.scope: Local cache publication time is not network time. Initial runtime transfer includes the shared graph. Source-only updates reuse it; graph input changes require a new graph. Shared real paths change module identity and implicit registry-to-workspace lookup behavior. Default standalone layout unchanged.

validation.independent_pnpm: CI 611 instances, local fixtures, patches, all input modes, zero-registry Vue reactivity
validation.tampering: shared payload corruption and redirected instance roots rejected
validation.output_paths: nested and unsafe materialize destinations rejected before copying
